normalized_requirement: Add optional user-selected custom aliases to link creation without breaking existing links or clients; duplicate alias returns a clear conflict.
assumptions: Aliases share the same code column/namespace as generated codes.
A fixed reserved-name list is rejected.

acceptance_criteria.statement: POST /api/links accepts optional custom_alias; valid alias is stored as code and returned.
Invalid alias pattern or reserved alias returns 422.
Requests without custom_alias behave exactly as before.
Existing rows, generated codes, and click counts are preserved unchanged.

notes: Brownfield; contract for aliases is fully specified, no clarification needed.
